description: HIFLD OPEN Submarine Cable Lines (USACE IENC) is a data set deposited in ICPSR by its authors United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Department of Homeland Security. Cable, submarine Definition: An assembly of wires or fibres, or a wire rope or chain which has been laid underwater or buried beneath the seabed (Hydrographic Service, Royal Australian Navy). Coverage: several countries (AU, US); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and ICPSR normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-icpsr-repository.
